summary: Remove interface/monster; guide-map event marker from the map kit creatures
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25, on `staged/client/sprites/interface/monster`: "Can be entirely removed as it isn't going to be used anymore since the map kit has all of the monsters and more".

| fact | value |
|---|---|
| sheet | `staged/client/sprites/interface/monster/000.png` (21,955 B) plus manifest.json; 100 frames of 28x28, pivot -14,-14 - measured |
| loader | `sources/client/screen_loading.cpp:182` `make_sprite("interface/monster", InterfaceMonster, 1, false)` (as of 2026-11-25) |
| id | `sources/client/sprite_id.h:20` `InterfaceMonster = 50` |
| only draw | `sources/client/dialog_box_guide_map.cpp:123`: the blinking monster-event marker at (m_event_x, m_event_y), frame m_monster_id |
| replacement | `staged/client/sprites/mapkit/creatures.{png,json}`, keyed by creature with npc_type / npc_ids and a pivot; drawing code is in `parchment_kit.{h,cpp}` - located |

**Done when:**
- The guide-map event marker draws the matching map-kit creature icon, sized to fit the minimap marker.
- The interface/monster load, `InterfaceMonster` and the folder are gone.
- The folder is archived byte-identical to `working/archive/interface/monster/`.
- Both builds are clean.

Source: user message, 2026-11-25.
